ryOS for iPhone

The ryOS desktop, in your pocket.

ryOS for iPhone runs the whole ryOS web desktop in a native shell. It loads fast from cache, tells you when chat messages arrive, and fills every iPhone display — including the iPhone Duo's large inner display.

Fast, even offline

The desktop loads from cache, so it's up in seconds — and comes up with no network at all.

Chat notifications

New chat messages reach you while the app is closed, and a tap takes you straight to the room.

Made for iPhone Duo

Fold it open and the desktop fills the large display, edge to edge.

Coming soon to the App Store.
